categories.main_business_segments: Inner Mongolia Yili Industrial Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the dairy industry, focusing on the production and sales of liquid milk, milk powder, yogurt, frozen dairy products, cheese, dairy fat, and packaged drinking water. The company organizes its operations into six main product business groups: liquid milk, infant nutrition, adult nutrition, frozen dairy products, yogurt, and cheese. It also has overseas subsidiaries engaged in dairy product manufacturing and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced production technologies including global supply chain integration with production bases in Asia, Oceania, and Europe. It uses big data and AI technologies for optimizing supply chain, production, and logistics. Key innovations include active lactoferrin extraction, probiotic encapsulation technology for shelf-stable products, lactose-free milk powder production, and sustainable packaging innovations such as recycled PET and plant-based materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yili serves a broad customer base including retail consumers across urban and rural China, infant and adult nutrition markets, and professional foodservice clients such as bakeries and tea shops. It also targets overseas markets with exports and subsidiaries in Southeast Asia, New Zealand, Europe, and other regions. The company’s products cater to diverse consumer needs including health-conscious, elderly, and infant nutrition segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s primary market is domestic China with extensive coverage across North China, South China, Central China, East China, and other regions. It operates 81 production bases globally and exports products to over 60 countries and regions. Overseas subsidiaries are located in New Zealand, Thailand, Indonesia, the Netherlands, and Hong Kong, supporting its international expansion strategy.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yili operates across the entire dairy supply chain, including upstream raw milk sourcing through embedded service and interest linkage mechanisms, midstream production and processing with advanced manufacturing facilities, and downstream distribution via a comprehensive multi-channel sales network covering supermarkets, convenience stores, e-commerce, O2O, and foodservice channels. It also manages logistics and inventory through digital platforms and third-party partnerships.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in nutrition and health, sustainable development, and digital transformation. R&D focuses on functional dairy products, infant formula enhancements based on global breast milk research, probiotic technologies, lactose-free products, and sustainable packaging. It is advancing AI-driven product development and marketing, and participates in national key research projects on nutrition and chronic disease management.
categories.revenue_model: Yili generates revenue primarily through product sales of dairy and health food products. It employs a mixed sales model dominated by distribution via dealers and supplemented by direct sales. Revenue streams include domestic retail sales, exports, and sales to institutional clients. The company also earns investment income from equity holdings and financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yili is the leading dairy company in China and Asia, ranking among the top five globally. It holds the largest market shares in liquid milk, infant formula, adult milk powder, cheese, and frozen dairy products in China. Its main competitors include other major Chinese dairy firms and international dairy companies operating in the Chinese market. Yili emphasizes brand strength, product innovation, and supply chain efficiency to maintain its leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Yili reported consolidated operating revenue of approximately RMB 115.4 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 8.45 billion, reflecting a decline compared to the previous year due to market challenges. The company has total assets exceeding RMB 153 billion and net assets attributable to shareholders around RMB 53 billion. It maintains strong cash flow from operations and continues investing in capacity expansion and digital transformation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yili emphasizes high product quality, innovation, and health-oriented nutrition solutions as its core value proposition. It differentiates through a diversified product portfolio addressing various consumer segments, advanced R&D capabilities including global breast milk research, and sustainable practices such as carbon neutrality and low water footprint initiatives. The company’s strong brand equity, extensive distribution network, and digital engagement further enhance its competitive advantage.
